context: The existing explicit profile activates only a loose custom lens. A successful creation must copy and actively reference all four defaults, add a bespoke lens, and preserve the custom entry and profile settings.

checklist.name: Private package manifest
checklist.description: review-lenses/.tessl-plugin/plugin.json exists, is valid JSON, names local/code-review, uses version 0.1.0, sets private true, and points skills at ./skills/

checklist.name: All defaults copied
checklist.description: The four default lens SKILL.md files exist under review-lenses/skills with their original names and substantive instructions

checklist.name: All defaults activated
checklist.description: .tessl-code-review.yml actively references each of the four copied defaults by a resolving local path, with no registry default refs left behind

checklist.name: Defaults have broad coverage
checklist.description: None of the four copied default entries has globs, so none remains dormant or restricted to a newly invented scope

checklist.name: Custom coverage preserved
checklist.description: The existing review-compliance ref, globs, and effort remain semantically unchanged

checklist.name: Profile settings preserved
checklist.description: schemaVersion, effort, reviewMode, requestChangesAt, and ignore remain semantically unchanged

checklist.name: Bespoke lens added
checklist.description: A fifth package lens addresses the checkpoint compatibility rule from AGENTS.md and is activated with justified focused globs

checklist.name: Refs and behavior checked
checklist.description: result-notes.md confirms local refs resolve, checks applicable-lens limits and glob behavior, and reports positive, negative, and unavailable behavioral checks honestly
